description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to direct that a duty at the rate of a Rs. 1850.00 per proof litre on Molasses, Palmyrah, Coconut and Processed Arrack and a duty at the rate of Rs. 2030.00 on every proof litre on country made Foreign spirits manufactured in Sri Lanka shall be levied and a duty at the rate of Rs. 160.00 shall be imposed on malt liquor of less than 5% and above of absolute strength and a duty shall not be levied on such brewery issued for the use of any Diplomatic Mission with effect from 21.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette content contains three Excise Notifications (Nos. 978, 979, 980) issued under the Excise Ordinance that establish new excise duty rates on various alcoholic beverages (molasses, palmyrah, coconut and processed arrack; country made foreign spirits; malt liquor). These notifications represent regulatory changes and statutory instruments that modify existing tax regulations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While the Minister of Finance is named, this is incidental to the regulatory nature of the content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would make it a government-related type.
